title: Campaign config
description: campaignConfig.json in a campaign folder: the campaign's details and how its missions unlock.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema for this file, for editor autocomplete and errors. The client ignores it.

formatVersion.title: Format version
formatVersion.description: Version of the content format this file follows. Leave it out for version 1. A client that supports an older version reports the content as needing a newer client. This client supports version 1.

campaignId.title: Campaign id
campaignId.description: Id of the campaign. Must equal the campaign's folder name, and stays the same once released.

titleKey.title: Title key
titleKey.description: Language key of the campaign's title, looked up in shared/language/.

descriptionKey.title: Description key
descriptionKey.description: Language key of the campaign's description, looked up in shared/language/.

backgroundImage.title: Background image
backgroundImage.description: Image file in the campaign's shared/media/ folder.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Image file in the campaign's shared/media/ folder.

players.title: Player counts
players.description: Every number of human players the campaign supports. Each mission needs a config for each count, or a default config.

items.title: Player count
items.description: A number of human players the campaign can be played with.

settings.title: Campaign settings
settings.description: Settings that apply to every mission unless the mission overrides them.

replayableMissions.title: Replayable missions
replayableMissions.description: Whether missions stay available after they are won. Defaults to false.

missions.title: Missions
missions.description: Every mission in the campaign, keyed by mission id. Each id must equal a mission folder name and that mission's `missionId`, and stays the same once released.

^(.*)$.title: Campaign mission
^(.*)$.description: How a mission unlocks and is unlocked. A mission becomes available when any mission that unlocks it is played, or when all its prerequisites are won.

settings.title: Mission settings
settings.description: Settings for this mission that override the campaign's.

replayable.title: Replayable
replayable.description: Whether the mission stays available after it is won. Overrides the campaign's `settings.replayableMissions`.

victoryUnlocks.title: Unlocked on victory
victoryUnlocks.description: Missions that become available when this mission is won.

victoryRemoves.title: Removed on victory
victoryRemoves.description: Missions that stop being available when this mission is won.

failureUnlocks.title: Unlocked on failure
failureUnlocks.description: Missions that become available when this mission is lost.

failureRemoves.title: Removed on failure
failureRemoves.description: Missions that stop being available when this mission is lost.

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
prerequisites.description: Missions that must all be won before this mission becomes available.

startMission.title: Start missions
startMission.description: Missions available when the campaign starts.

finalMission.title: Final missions
finalMission.description: Missions that finish the campaign when won.

compatibility.title: Compatibility
compatibility.description: Engine and game pairs this content has been tested with. Each entry pairs one engine with its games, and only those pairs count. List each engine once.

items.title: Compatible engine and games
items.description: One engine version and the game versions that work with it.

engineVersion.title: Engine version
engineVersion.description: Exact engine version, as the client names installed engines. Rapid tags and wildcards are not accepted.

gameVersions.title: Game versions
gameVersions.description: Every game version that works with this engine version. A game listed here pairs with this engine only.

items.title: Game version
items.description: Exact game version, the full version string of the game archive. Rapid tags such as `byar:test` are not accepted.
